title: ParzifaL
tagline: My project for the hackathon is centered around gamifying NFT minting, Players receive a 'secret phrase' which they use to find unique NFT items through minting from the collection. Totally random. Totally awesome.
description:
parzifalsHunt is an NFT-Gamification experience of treasure hunting by collecting NFTs. An NFT Collection containing treasure-emoji-items has been created using NFTPort API

The process starts by generating a unique seed phrase on the homepage. Then subsequently minting NFTs from the collection. The goal of course is to acquire all the treasure items as indicated by your unique seed phrase. 

An NFTMarketplace has been created to ease the process of trading with other people. Happy questing :D
how_its_made:
parzifalsHunt is an NFT-Gamification experience of treasure hunting by collecting NFTs. An NFT Collection containing treasure-emoji-items has been created using NFTPort API

The process starts by generating a unique seed phrase on the homepage. Then subsequently minting NFTs from the collection. The goal of course is to acquire all the treasure items as indicated by your unique seed phrase. 

An NFTMarketplace has been created to ease the process of trading with other people. Happy questing :D

The NFT Collection is built ontop of NFTPort API with the NFTs and metadata stored on IPFS. Pinata/IPFS is also being used to handle the marketplace.json data, interactions and metadata. The code was published on Valist.
